shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' app/catalog/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -c "cat lib/data.ts && printf '\\n--- config files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'next.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g 'app/**' -g 'lib/**' -g 'README*' | sort"

/bin/bash -c "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print 2>/dev/null | head -50; printf '\\n--- versions ---\\n'; node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- lock change summary ---\\n'; git diff -- package.json;"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/page.tsx
@@
-            <Link href={"'`/catalog?category=${category.slug}`}>
+            <Link href={`/catalog?category=${category.slug}`} prefetch={true}>
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build'
/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH

git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c 'git clean -fd -- .next && git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json'
